summary: This video announces a community giveaway hosted by liveranov for November. Viewers can participate for a chance to win one of five codes, with each code rewarding three Heliolite Dice. Participation requires liking the video and leaving a comment prior to the November 8th deadline. The video serves purely as an announcement and contains no gameplay guides, tier lists, or character reviews.
title: Community Giveaway November (Round 1) | Entry OPEN
